notes.title: Balance Patch 1.0_040925
notes.content:
[p]Based on your feedback, we’ve just rolled out a balance update with the following changes:[/p][p][b]
Abilities[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Elusive [/b](skeletons’ passive ability)[b]:[/b] Effect reduced from 50% → 30%.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Burst [/b](dagger ability used by cutthroats)[b]:[/b] Damage reduced by 2 and it no longer applies a debuff.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Units[/b][/p][list][*][p]Regular enemies in the second act now have their [b]Power[/b] reduced by 2.

[/p][/*][/list][p]Have fun on the battlefield! ⚔️[/p]
